release_notes: - Retry turnOn() when HTTP fails during active meeting (device stays ON). - Minimum recording duration: skip transcription for meetings under 30s. - Audio merge: system + mic tracks merged for better transcription context. - Claude prompt improved: identifies user voice via mic track comparison. - FileHandle crash fix: explicit close on failure prevents fd leak. - Free/Pro split: recording features conditionally compiled (RECORDING_ENABLED). - Configuration screen hides recording options in Free version. - Separate build scripts and Sparkle update channels for Free and Pro.
